Class VectorAdapterTest

java.lang.Object
myTest.VectorAdapterTest
public class VectorAdapterTest extends Object
Test suite for the VectorAdapter class.

This test suite verifies the functionality of the VectorAdapter class, which implements the HList and HCollection interfaces to provide a growable dynamic array of objects. The tests cover various scenarios including construction, basic usage, element manipulation, collection manipulation, edge cases and error conditions.

Test Case Design

The test cases are designed to validate the behavior of VectorAdapter against the specifications of Java 1.4.2 Vector class. The test design includes categories for basic functionality, edge cases, error conditions, and compliance with the HList and HCollection interfaces.

Categories:

  • Constructor tests
  • Capacity and size management tests
  • Element access and modification tests
  • Collection operation tests
  • Iterator and enumeration tests
  • Edge case and exception handling tests

Testing Framework Information

This test suite utilizes JUnit 4.13 testing framework with Hamcrest 1.3 matchers for assertions. These dependencies are located as follows:

  • JUnit 4.13: JUnit/junit-4.13.jar
  • Hamcrest Core 1.3: JUnit/hamcrest-core-1.3.jar
